description: OpenMobilityData is a data resource listed in awesome-transit (MobilityData), a community list of transit data, APIs and tools under the section "Sharing Data > 3rd party GTFS URL directories", published or maintained by as named on openmobilitydata.org. List of GTFS and GTFS-RT feeds. Archives and validates the GTFS feeds and allows you to preview both GTFS and GTFS-RT through the browser. Formerly TransitFeeds.com. MobilityData announced it is end-of-life as of early 2022 with a shutdown date to be determined. Coverage: as described in the entry; the linked page was not read. The list files it under "Sharing Data > 3rd party GTFS URL directories". The list marks it as deprecated. The entry links to openmobilitydata.org. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the list entry (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport and planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-awesome-transit-community-list.
